subject: Request: New security hires + tiered offer clearance
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, BrightPath Talent <talent@brightpath.co>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: New security hires + tiered offer clearance

Team —

Following our quarterly planning, Security needs two hires to hit our Q1 roadmap commitments:

- Senior Security Engineer (SecEng II) — core infra/runtimes (1 FTE)
- GRC Manager — compliance & audit program lead (1 FTE)

I attached a headcount request workbook (hc_request_20261115.xlsx) and the latest comp bands (comp_bands_v4.pdf). Quick asks:
1) Confirm these roles are OK to open (headcount & budget).
2) Sign off on the proposed tiered offer ranges so Talent can proceed with outreach.

Proposed offer ranges (base + equity):
- SecEng II: $170k–$205k base; target comp $220k–$260k
- GRC Manager: $150k–$185k base; target comp $180k–$215k

BrightPath has a warmed candidate (Ethan Morris) who matches SecEng II — CV attached. Can we get a decisions thread by EOD Tuesday so Talent can schedule interviews and we can pre-clear offer bands with Finance?

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
VP, Product Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: hc_request_20261115.xlsx; comp_bands_v4.pdf; candidate_cv_ethan_morris.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: New security hires + tiered offer clearance

Lauren —

Thanks for the packet. A couple of quick notes from finance:
- We have the budget for two FTEs in Q1 as long as hiring is headcount-neutral to other non-critical roles (I flagged HC-42).
- Bands look reasonable, but request we tighten SecEng II base to $175k–$200k and set the target comp max to $245k to control burn.
- For GRC Manager, can HR confirm if this role is grade 4 or grade 5 in the comp_bands_v4.pdf? That will determine bonus eligibility.

If HR confirms the grade and Talent provides final candidate expectations, Finance can pre-approve the spend for offers up to the band tops above.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Finance (Product)
Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: New security hires + tiered offer clearance

Quick update from hiring:
- We have 3 active pipelines for SecEng II (two sourced directly, one inbound via BrightPath). Ethan Morris (attached CV) is senior, comes from a distributed systems background, expects $210k total comp.
- GRC Manager: recruiters have 4 prospects; typical market ask is at top of the posted band. This hire is priority for our SOC2 roadmap and vendor audits.

I recommend we:
1) Approve the SecEng II band Marcus proposed ($175k–$200k base; $220k target comp cap) and allow up to $210k total comp for candidates with critical infra experience without exec sign-off.
2) Approve the GRC Manager band as grade 4 but allow flex to grade 5 (with Rishi approval) if candidate brings enterprise compliance + audit program experience.

Can Monica confirm grade mapping and draft the formal offer templates for both tiers? If we green-light this, Talent will schedule on-site interviews for Ethan next week.

Thanks,
Mina
Principal Security Engineer (Hiring Lead)
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 13:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: New security hires + tiered offer clearance

Team —

Confirmed: GRC Manager maps to grade 4 in comp_bands_v4.pdf. Grade 5 requires SR Director sponsorship; we'll only escalate if candidate clearly warrants that level.

I've attached a one-page offer guide (comp_bands_v4.pdf) and a draft offer template for each role. Per Marcus' note, I'll block the pre-approved thresholds in our ATS:
- SecEng II: base $175k–$200k; max total comp for pre-approved offers $210k
- GRC Manager (grade 4): base $150k–$185k; pre-approve up to $195k total comp — above that requires Rishi sign-off.

Next steps for Talent: draft offers within those ranges, include standard equity package (RSU schedule) and standard benefits. Please route any above-threshold requests to Rishi for expedited review (cc'd).

Monica Patel
Head of Talent Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: comp_bands_v4.pdf (annotated); offer_templates_sec_and_grc.docx
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, BrightPath Talent <talent@brightpath.co>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: New security hires + tiered offer clearance

Approved per Monica's annotated bands.
- Talent: proceed with scheduling Ethan's onsite loop and prepare a potential offer at up to $210k total comp if we need to move quickly.
- Monica: lock the template and grade 4 mapping; escalate to Rishi only if a candidate requires >$195k total for GRC Manager.
- Mina: prioritize SecEng II interviews next week and share interview panel availability.

Let's keep this thread for any exceptions. Thanks all.

—Marcus
Director, Finance (Product)
Redwood Inference
